title: Luminous Angel Sphere
description: A painted glass sphere sculpture features a central glowing angelic figure with wings, standing on a dark pedestal. Radiating from the angel's core are vibrant branching neural-like structures in yellow, blue, and pink connecting to a crowd of stylized green human silhouettes against a purple cosmic background with swirling patterns and floating circles.
prompt: A painted glass sphere sculpture showing a glowing purple angel with wings standing at the center of a cosmic scene. Bright yellow, blue and pink branching energy tendrils radiate outward from a luminous orb at the angel's chest connecting to a surrounding crowd of green stylized human silhouettes. The background contains purple sky, white clouds, floating circles and spiral patterns in a vibrant surreal symbolic style.
